title: Verbal System / Growing up
slide_intent: Use a familiar phrase with an unexpected turn because a message can express personality while explaining growth.
strategic_value: The poster’s refusal to equate growth with formality can preserve Mailchimp’s independent character as it expands.
demonstration: An oversized serif headline fills a white poster on foliage, with unusual black-and-yellow drawings inserted between lines.
practical_value: Compare how wordplay and illustration support the same attitude.

content_islands.name: Headline
content_islands.spec: Let the large multiline headline dominate the tilted white poster.

content_islands.name: Drawings
content_islands.spec: Insert surreal objects between headline lines and near the foot without replacing the words.

content_islands.name: Setting
content_islands.spec: Retain the surrounding foliage as the photographed context.

reference_purposes.Expression: The poster combines a conversational growth message with unusual drawings.
reference_purposes.Application: The verbal system is demonstrated on a physical poster.
